Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 measurements on target CHEMBL1904 (human single-protein target). Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary to compound_structures. Filter to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
